body:
This is kind of by design, you have two applications present (the dev mode one and the test one) and only one can configure logging. Any %test logging config is ignored, and dev mode logging settings are used instead. 

In Quarkus upstream pressing 's' would restart the app and apply the logging changes. But I can't really see a good solution for this.

On an unrelated note this has given me an idea around logging and the console...
Hmm, looks like this is also a problem for mvn quarkus:test. I will fix that.
Thanks. I didn't even think of the app being in test mode, although it is "continuous *TESTING*", LOL.
Closing this issue, understanding that this will be fixed with #18331

That PR does not really fix it, it allows you to easily toggle the log level from the console (the idea I mentioned above).

I am working on a PR now that will fix it for mvn quarkus:test, but the mvn quarkus:dev mode behaviour won't change.

issue.title: InMemoryHandler keeps log level set in dev mode
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

When using `InMemoryHandler` from `quarkus-junit5-internal` module for capturing logs, we discovered that running just tests and running continuous tests in dev mode yields different results.

We are creating custom test profile for our test class, where we lower the log level and try to capture these logs. We suspect it has something to do with the handler being static, thus keeping the log level from dev mode and not being recreated in tests.

### Expected behavior

Work the same running `./mvnw clean quarkus:test` and `./mvnw clean quarkus:dev` + pressing `r` for running tests, i.e. test passing

### Actual behavior

Tests having different results

### How to Reproduce?

Reproducer with readme: [https://github.com/The-Huginn/inMemoryHandlerReproducer](https://github.com/The-Huginn/inMemoryHandlerReproducer)

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

Linux fedora 6.4.6-200.fc38.x86_64

### Output of `java -version`

Java version: 17.0.7, vendor: Eclipse Adoptium

### GraalVM version (if different from Java)

GraalVM CE 22.3.1

### Quarkus version or git rev

3.2.3.Final

_No response_
